mapper.select:
SELECT DISTINCT t.class_number, t.class_name, t.class_description, t.class_image, t.user_number, t.class_category_number, t.start_date, t.end_date, t.is_daily, t.duration_weeks, t.class_time, ST_AsText(t.location) AS location, c.class_category_name AS categoryName FROM tb_class t JOIN tb_class_category c ON t.class_category_number = c.class_category_number
JOIN tb_class_keyword tk ON t.class_number = tk.class_number JOIN tb_detail_keyword dk ON tk.keyword_number = dk.keyword_number
WHERE 1=1
AND c.class_category_name = #{categoryName}
AND dk.keyword_name = #{detailKeywordName}
AND t.class_name LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
ORDER BY t.class_number DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_class ( class_name, class_description, user_number, class_category_number, start_date, end_date, class_time, location ) VALUES ( #{className}, #{classDescription}, #{userNumber}, #{classCategoryNumber}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{classTime}, ST_SetSRID(#{location, typeHandler=lx.team2.backend.common.handler.JtsPointTypeHandler}, 4326) )
mapper.select: SELECT keyword_number FROM tb_detail_keyword WHERE keyword_name = #{keywordName}
